messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
From which date does Article 50(1) of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 (Member States' duty to lay down penalties) apply?

response.text: Da quale data si applica l'articolo 50, paragrafo 1, del regolamento (UE) 2023/1230 (obbligo degli Stati membri di stabilire le sanzioni)?
